name: manipur-economy
description: The Price of Conflict — source-of-truth report on Manipur's conflict economy

scripts.lint: eslint assets/js tests scripts eslint.config.js playwright.config.mjs
scripts.lint:fix: eslint assets/js tests scripts eslint.config.js playwright.config.mjs --fix
scripts.minify: cleancss -o assets/css/site.min.css assets/css/site.css && terser assets/js/utils.js -o assets/js/utils.min.js --module --compress --mangle && terser assets/js/map.js -o assets/js/map.min.js --module --compress --mangle && terser assets/js/charts.js -o assets/js/charts.min.js --module --compress --mangle && terser assets/js/main.js -o assets/js/main.min.js --module --compress --mangle && sed -i 's|from"\./utils\.js"|from"./utils.min.js"|g; s|from"\./map\.js"|from"./map.min.js"|g; s|from"\./charts\.js"|from"./charts.min.js"|g' assets/js/map.min.js assets/js/charts.min.js assets/js/main.min.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:a11y
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:all && npm run check:seo && npm run check:content
